sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Loss of conception of time. Difficult enun-
:iation. Distrust and resentment. Lazy contentment.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Aches, with disturbed vision. Fantastic,
brilliant, moving colored objects. Affected by beating
time. Pupils dilated, vertigo, brain tired. Polychrome
spectra. Exaggerated reverberation of ordinary sounds.
